author: raoatifshad
body:
This PR adds the script that sends the scan results from #2908 to the IB chatbot and then deletes them.

It is simpler for your machine than my first version: there are no `.sent` files any more and nothing is left behind in the build folders.

How it works:
- It takes the files waiting in `/data/sdt/chatbot-outbox` and sends many of them in one request.
- A file is deleted once the chatbot confirms that it has received exactly that file.
- If the chatbot VM is down, the files stay and are sent in the next run. After 3 days they are deleted, so the folder cannot grow forever.
- If the chatbot refuses a file, it normally keeps its own copy, so nobody has to look after it on cmssdt9-02.
- It also tells the chatbot which RelVal jobs have finished, by looking at the `done.*` files. It only reads them.

It runs in the Jenkins job `send-test-log-scans` on `cmssdt`, which already exists and is still disabled:

    python3 $CMS_BOT_DIR/send_test_log_scans.py --url http://cmssdt-chatbot.cern.ch:8001

The job goes red if the token is wrong, and unstable if a file was refused or has been waiting for more than an hour. A short interruption of the VM is not an error.
title: Send the IB test-log scan files to the IB chatbot
